# Croom CPR p. 116 — Baptisms Jan–Aug 1876

**Source image:** `page_116_baptism_jan_aug1876.jpg` (this directory)
**NLI:** Croom parish 0881, microfilm 02427/07
**Coverage:** Jan 1876 – Aug 1876

## Status for our research

**CLEAN NEGATIVE for "Honoria/Nora filia Patricii Gleeson et Margaritae Moloney" baptism.** Verified across **four AI passes** during 2026-06-05 session (ChatGPT + multiple Gemini image-references); no entry for Patrick + Margaret Moloney parents in this window. See [[gleeson-nora-1876-1939-sister]] for why this matters.

## Notable kin-network entries

- **6 Mar 1876 (Die 6to):** Maria, filia Michaelis Carroll et **Annae Gleeson**. Sponsors Patricio [Enright?] + Maria Guiry. → Anna Gleeson as Croom mother 1876; possible Patrick-sister candidate or different Croom Gleeson family. Surname-watch.
- **12 May 1876 (Die 12mo, In Ergastulo):** Joseph, illegitimate, filius **Charles Moloney** [one pass reads "Michaelis Moloney"] + Catherinae Drew, de Poor House / de Parochia Crecora. Sponsor: Johanna Synch / Thomâ Lynch. → Moloney-kin-network watch; possible kin to Margaret Moloney.
- **18 Jun 1876 (Die 18mo):** Alicia, filia **Joannis Moloney** [one pass misread as "Birney"] et Johanna Gavin. Sponsors Gulielmo Quaid + Ellena Dwyer. → John Moloney + Johanna Gavin as Croom couple 1876; second possible brother-of-Margaret candidate (see [[gleeson-james-moloney-margaret-brother]]).

## Pass D (ChatGPT, earliest single-pass attempt)

Lower-confidence pass; surname readings diverged from later passes on multiple entries (e.g., "Birney" for what later passes read as "Joannis Moloney"; "Caines+Jordan" for what later passes read as "Cagney+Irwin"). Notable July + August entries (sparse):

`In Mense Julii: Die 12mo Catherina, filia Joannis Sez[?] et Catherinae Niman[?]. Spons. Michaele Purcell et Maria Purcell.`

`In Mense Augusti: Die 8vo Anna, filia Gulielmi Farrell et Ellenae Quinn. Spons. Brigida Purcell et Thoma Bourke.`
